fusions.name: Scamper Strike
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target, then it takes 13 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Thumper Ring
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 2 tiles takes 4 damage.

fusions.name: Bolt Hole
fusions.desc: Carries you 4 tiles forward in a burst, and you move 20% faster for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Running Lead
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 6 seconds.
